venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 2/25.** Slow start, first seating 5:45; steady 6-9 mostly reservations; most guests chose tables, bar sometimes relatively empty; bar and floor cleared together and all closed out by 11:30. Kitchen: 16% of sales; some tables came more hungry than thirsty; down a chef but Kevin stepped in to cover and keep the kitchen open. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 2/25.** Very slow Wednesday; dates and bizarre ring-transfer routines; guests included the proprietor of Jacob's Pickles (learned highball riffs are drier than tonic riffs) and the Rona family returning. Comps $121.37. Top sellers: Masari, Root & Rye, Jabalina. Door: mostly twos and solos, only three parties over two; six birthday reservations (about 9 guests, one with a cake) and Sean's birthday at midnight; most walk-ins repeat locals; 6pm brought an investor walk-in of 5 and 6 solos; never exceeded half capacity; quiet by 11pm. No no-shows.
